description: Draw a presenter of the team's own from a description of how they look, as the app's Describe a presenter does: an adult, invented, not a real person or a character. Free, and counted against the team's 5 drawings a day; a description refused, or a drawing that fails, gives its drawing back. Answers an id at once: call get_described with it every few seconds until its status is ready or refused.

description.description: How the presenter looks: age, hair, clothes, manner. In a few words or more.

name.description: A name to call them by. Left out, they are numbered.

name: describe_presenter
title: Describe a presenter
